title: Commander Advice
description: One commander advice item (CA): a statement that shapes or bounds a single conceptual unit of infrastructure (a file, a file type, a location, a concept, a harness extension), held in the commander's own words, verbatim. Filed under its unit's own sub-directory, with a manifest per unit and a global manifest over all units. Retired and eventually pruned if no longer relevant; a whole unit is retired if it becomes wholly irrelevant. Filed by identifier with a dash, CA-012.json.
x-expect: exactly one of statement (one verbatim span) or statements (a bracketed list of verbatim spans, for a record drawn from two or more non-adjacent places) is present

kind.description: the word commander-advice, which is what chooses this schema

id.description: this advice item's identifier, CA, a dash and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for; numbering is global across every unit and never reused

unit.description: the conceptual unit of infrastructure this advice belongs to, a lowercase word or hyphenated words, matching the sub-directory it is filed in

name.description: one to three words the writer chose for the record's contents, appended to the file name after the id (CA-049)

date.description: the day the commander gave it, YYYY-MM-DD

session.description: the eight-character id of the session the advice was given in

status.description: whether the advice stands: active while it shapes the unit, retired once no longer relevant

summary.description: a plain-language summary of the whole advice item, simple words with no jargon; only this text goes to the unit's manifest

answered_by.description: the pilot decision that answers this advice item, mirroring the manifest row; absent until a decision is written

statement.description: the commander's own words, verbatim and never edited; present when the advice is drawn from one span of the constitution or transcript. Exactly one of statement or statements is present, never both

statements.description: the commander's own words, verbatim and never edited, as a bracketed list of two or more spans, used in place of statement when the advice is stated in two or more non-adjacent places, such as two separate lines of the constitution with an unrelated sentence between them. Each entry is one contiguous span in document order; the spans are never joined into one string, since that would read as continuous prose and stop being verbatim

lines.description: the constitution line or lines this advice is sourced from, a string such as "8", "31-32", "58-63" or "3, 52, 54", so the statement can be checked against the document in one step; present for a record sourced from the constitution, absent for one given in chat

context.description: the surrounding transcript context: what prompted the advice and what it applies to, in prose. Named context rather than brief in a CA record specifically (CA-003), unlike CO and CQ which keep brief

superseded_by.description: the identifier of the later advice item that overrides this one, and nothing else; absent while it stands

superseded_note.description: how and why it was superseded, in prose, when the identifier alone does not tell the story

note.description: a short note by the commander or the pilot on the record's status, such as why it was retired
